title: A 2D Co-MOF nanosheet for boosting alkaline water splitting through electrocatalytic urea oxidation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01265A, Paper
Anirban Ghosh, Tapas Sen, Asim Bhaumik
We report a novel 2D MOF, Co-IDBA-MOF, by a solvothermal method using a mixed ligand system and the material showed excellent electrocatalytic performance in the alkaline urea oxidation reaction (UOR) along with green hydrogen production.
